title: Vaporesso Luxe XR Replacement Pod
description:
The
Vaporesso Luxe XR Replacement Pod
is a refillable replacement pod with replaceable GTX coil system for all Luxe XR series devices. Supports both MTL and DTL vaping styles with the appropriate GTX coil.
Product Type:
Refillable Replacement Pod (Empty - Fill with E-Liquid)
E-Liquid Capacity:
5mL per Pod
Coil Resistance:
Replaceable - uses Vaporesso GTX Coils
Fill Method:
Bottom Fill
Compatible Devices:
Vaporesso Luxe XR, Luxe XR Max, Luxe XR Max 2
Brand:
Vaporesso
E-liquid and GTX coils sold separately.
Available options: MTL, DTL.
